purpose: Allow the common RunSpec upstream_config_path field to select a complete TabDiff TOML configuration while preserving the official TOML as the default.
input_treatment: applied after tabdiff-configurable-seed-overlay-v1 in the same in-memory module
invariants: The official configuration remains the default when no path is supplied.
The selected TOML is passed unchanged to the official src.load_config implementation.
No configuration key, model equation, training operation, or sampling operation is changed by this overlay.
The distributed TabDiff-main source remains byte-identical to the pinned official commit.
